notes: H1 own-risk MPT: monthly own-risk MPT returns are not released, so this family uses the released paired t-statistics (rescaled by sqrt(35/36) to match the small-sample correction) and has no bootstrap intervals. Incomplete solver paths are excluded.
H3 covers a separate 27-month window (Oct 2023 to Dec 2025); its effect sizes are not comparable with the 36-month H1 and H2 estimates.
